preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between n-1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of clones k is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid vertex indices between 1 and n.
The graph formed by n vertices and the given edges is connected.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly k lines, one for each clone.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(route) <= 6 for route in routes)
postconditions.description: Each clone's route visits at most 6 vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= v <= n for v in route) for route in routes)
postconditions.description: Every vertex index in every route is a valid vertex between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(all((route[i] in adj[route[i-1]]) or (route[i] == route[i-1]) for i in range(1, len(route))) for route in routes)
postconditions.description: For every route, consecutive vertices are either the same or connected by an edge in the graph.

postconditions.expression: set(range(1, n + 1)).issubset(set(v for route in routes for v in route))
postconditions.description: Every vertex from 1 to n is visited by at least one clone.
